msg: There are several pairs of gnomes that appear in each round. Each gnome in a pair rewards a different amount of points based on the mushrooms they have, so try to keep track of the pair combinations. You can see how many mushrooms they have visually. For example if the round is X5 and the gnome you pick has 6 mushrooms, giving 30 points, you can remember it started with 6 mushrooms. The mushroom amounts seem to change after each round completes.
